testcases.name: z-image-turbo
testcases.l0_replacement_reason: Z-Image-Turbo scale stays nightly; z-image-turbo-l0 keeps the Z-Image path at 512px for PR L0.
testcases.description: Z-Image-Turbo text-to-image (Qwen3 encoder + ZImage DiT + VAE)
testcases.test_prompt: A photo of a cat sitting on a windowsill at sunset
testcases.notes: Z-Image-Turbo uses an FP16 Qwen3 text encoder and DiT except for the VAE (selector 2), both noise refiners (3-4), and main DiT blocks 0-1 (7-8), which remain FP32. The context refiners, main blocks 2-29, and final layer remain FP16. Removing either noise refiner or main block 0/1 produces non-finite latents; an FP16 VAE produces a solid-white frame. The mixed bundle passes the unchanged 9-step Diffusers image contract.
